name: New Era Cap Co., LLC
note: US private headwear and apparel company (Buffalo, New York), founded in 1920 by Ehrhardt Koch. The company's foundation and the board biography of its CEO describe it as family-owned, led by fourth-generation CEO Christopher H. Koch; no state body or fund appears in the picture. Note: the Koch family of Buffalo, NY that owns New Era is not the Koch family behind Koch, Inc. (koch-inc) of Wichita, Kansas.
